stages.goal: Verify a legitimate grant/positive restoration and current source-owned conventional checks without a strawman.
Verify source-proposed suspension-time restore-condition declaration, then activation validation followed by fresh intent derivation, under full defended configuration.
Reevaluate the same decision under material change without changing R2 policy, rules, source access, adaptation or parameters. Distinguish changed world from available evidence.
